author: braggaboom
quote:
Filled to the brim with bugs and limits on what you can do. Many people have already listed these and showed clips so I won't rehash them here.

The story for this is so terrible. I gotta give em credit for one thing, they got the low value woman trope down to a T; many such cases. Jason is cucked and whipped throughout the whole game and you've gotta enable this horribly written character to get the "good" ending, how can anyone defend this garbage?

Low quality, toxic, promiscuous women primarily wrote the story for this trash, guaranteed.

Save your money from the humiliation ritual.
